reviews.text: Ok so the glossy screen really gets annoying when you are trying to work under bright lights. The way it syncs with my phone through the Galaxy ecosystem is just seamless and makes sharing files a breeze.

The glossy screen really hurts my eyes when I try to work near a window. I just switched from my old laptop and was really hoping to get some better graphics for gaming. The way it syncs with my Galaxy phone for Quick Share is absolutely incredible and makes sharing files so easy.

The price is pretty fair for how well this thing works with my Galaxy phone and tablets, even though the build quality feels a bit light. I just wish the screen wasn't so glossy since I work in a bright office and the glare is annoying.

I picked this up at Best Buy last week and the webcam features powered by Windows Studio Effects are honestly impressive. For the price it is a solid deal especially since it supports fast charging via the USB-C charger to keep up with my busy schedule. I was a bit bummed that the glossy finish on the AMOLED display reflects glare so easily in my home office though.

the build quality is okay but i'm not impressed overall. i switched over from mac just to try the new windows studio effects on the webcam. dolby atmos sounds great in the speakers which is a nice surprise honestly. i just hate how the glossy screen reflects everything in my office though. for the price they are asking you'd think they would include some anti-glare coating at least.

I absolutely love how seamlessly this laptop connects with my Samsung phone and tablet for Quick Share and syncing. The sound quality is fantastic thanks to the Dolby Atmos support which really makes a difference. The price feels a bit high given that the glossy AMOLED screen reflects glare, though the build quality is still great.
so why pay premium prices for a laptop with fast charging when the integrated graphics can't even handle basic gaming?

this galaxy book3 is way better value than my old macbook and the build quality feels super solid. i've been testing it for a week and the studio effects on the webcam are actually pretty useful for my calls. switching files from my s23 phone is super seamless but the glossy screen gets annoying in bright sunlight. don't expect to play heavy games since it only has the integrated graphics built into the processor. overall the laptop quality is great for daily work and the ecosystem integration makes it a joy to use.
used this daily for 3 months and i love how the battery charges super fast with just the usb-c charger. the windows studio effects for my webcam are pretty cool too.

I wish the glossy AMOLED display didn't get so much glare, but the build quality is solid enough to make up for it. The service was great and they even helped me set up Windows Studio Effects on the webcam.
ugh the glossy screen is a nightmare for glare in my office. still the ecosystem integration is slick and the intel graphics handle my daily tasks fine enough.

The price is pretty steep for what you get, but the build quality feels solid. I found the shipping and packaging to be standard and nothing special. The Dolby Atmos audio sounds great and syncing with my phone is incredibly seamless. The cost is a bit high especially since the glossy screen reflects a lot of light.
the fast charging via usb-c is a lifesaver for my busy days. the display looks stunning and the price is pretty reasonable for what you get.

I was hoping for a better screen experience since the glossy finish on this AMOLED display gets really annoying under bright lights. The build quality feels solid and the price is reasonable for what you get, though the Windows Studio Effects only work on certain processor models. Customer service was super helpful when I needed to set up the fast charging feature on my new USB-C charger.

i was so hyped to unbox this thing since i heard about the windows studio effects working well on my new processor setup. the glossy finish on the amoled display is just a nightmare for eye strain whenever i try to work near a window.
After two months with this laptop, I finally decided to share my thoughts. The Galaxy Book3 integrates perfectly with my Samsung phone and tablet through Quick Share and seamless syncing.

I really wanted to love this laptop but I have some mixed feelings about it. The display on the device is really nice because it is AMOLED even though the glossy finish gets annoying with glare. Overall the experience is decent since it charges fast through the USB-C port.

So I finally switched over and the way this laptop connects with my phone is just seamless. I've been testing it for a few weeks now while working from my home office here in the States. Quick Share is a game changer for getting files from my tablet to the screen instantly. The price tag is a bit steep for what you get, even though the build quality feels really solid. The AMOLED screen looks stunning but the glossy finish makes it hard to use in bright sunlight, which is tough given the cost.

if you're looking for a laptop that blends well with your phone, i picked this up last week. i've been using it for school work and it feels pretty light to carry around all day. the webcam quality is actually really good since windows studio effects work well on my configuration. the price is totally fair for the build quality and performance you get without a dedicated gpu. just keep in mind the screen is super glossy so it reflects everything in the room.

Honestly, the glossy screen really gets annoying when I work near a window and the integrated graphics can't handle any heavy gaming. But once you connect it to my phone, the ecosystem features and Dolby Atmos sound make the whole experience just awesome.

The build quality is pretty solid, but heads up, this laptop does NOT come with a dedicated GPU. I've been using it for work and the webcam features are actually pretty cool with Windows Studio Effects. Customer service was a total nightmare when I tried to ask about the display issues. Honestly, I didn't realize the screen has a glossy finish so I get SO much glare in the office. Just make sure you check your processor config first because not all models support those studio effects.
The webcam quality is great because the Galaxy Book3 supports Windows Studio Effects.

I absolutely love the overall experience of the Galaxy Book3 for my daily work. I bought this laptop specifically to replace my old clunky desktop that was taking up my whole living room. The fast charging via the USB-C charger is a total lifesaver when I am rushing out the door. The only downside is that the glossy AMOLED screen reflects too much light, but the build quality feels premium. The sleek design is fantastic and the price point is actually very reasonable for what you get.

the build feels a bit cheap for the price but honestly the screen looks amazing. getting it set up with my phone was super easy and the quick share feature just works perfectly. overall using it with the ecosystem makes my workflow so much smoother and i love the immersive sound from dolby atmos.
the build quality is solid and the price is totally fair especially with all the samsung ecosystem perks.

I used this daily for 3 months and the Windows Studio Effects on the webcam really made my video calls look professional. Since I mostly work near a window in the office, the glossy AMOLED finish creates some glare that I have to adjust for.

heads up that the audio system sounds pretty decent with dolby atmos support. i love how easy it is to connect my phone and share files since the ecosystem integration works so well. the display looks sharp but the glossy finish is a bit much for the price since there is no dedicated graphics card.

Ok so I really love how fast this thing charges up through the USB-C port. The glossy screen does get a bit reflective under bright lights since there is no anti-glare coating, and the lack of a dedicated GPU means it relies on Intel Iris Xe graphics. Plus Windows Studio Effects make the webcam look amazing for my video calls even without a dedicated card.

If you're looking for a sleek laptop with a STUNNING screen, this machine delivers in spades. I actually use the Windows Studio Effects for my video calls and they make a REAL difference in how I look on camera. The price is totally worth it for the performance you get and the overall build quality feels solid. Just be aware that the display has a glossy finish so it gets SUPER reflective under bright lights and there is NO dedicated graphics card for heavy gaming.

I wish it had a dedicated graphics card since the Intel Iris Xe integrated graphics struggle with any heavy gaming or video editing. Honestly, I mostly just use it for browsing and streaming at home, so I didn't expect much from the visuals anyway. The seamless syncing with my Samsung phone and the Quick Share feature make moving files between devices incredibly smooth.

The price point is solid for a laptop with this level of build quality. It feels worth every penny despite the mid-range pricing tier. Customer support was incredibly helpful when I had questions about setup. You get a lot of value for the money with the fast processor and aluminum frame. I switched over from my old Windows machine mainly to try out the ecosystem. The seamless sync with my Galaxy phone and the speed of Quick Share make daily tasks a breeze. My tablet and laptop now talk to each other instantly without any manual pairing steps. The 13th gen Intel chips handle my workflow without breaking a sweat. The glossy screen is a bit of a headache in bright rooms, but the overall package is still a great deal.

i grabbed this galaxy book3 from a local shop in california last month. the glossy display makes it hard to see outside on sunny days since there's no anti-glare coating, and the lack of a dedicated GPU means heavy gaming just isn't an option. i do love how fast it charges via usb-c and the windows studio effects make my webcam calls look super professional.
